title: Bridge Call: Superior Range Electric Moving Early

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Entity Conference Bridge, Primary Control Room Desk 1

caller.name: Shift Supervisor, Superior Range Electric
caller.label: Superior Range Electric System Control (neighboring TOP)

callee.name: Walter Nakamura
callee.label: NLTO Control Room Shift Supervisor, Day Shift

transcript.speaker: Superior Range
transcript.text: NLTO, Superior Range Electric system control on the bridge. UMRC, you're on too, I hope. Quick heads-up for both of you.

transcript.speaker: NLTO CRSS
transcript.text: Superior Range, NLTO control room. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Superior Range
transcript.text: We're closing in our capacitor banks at ten hundred. We're moving to our Condition 2 actions now, ninety minutes before the arrival window opens at eleven. Real-time Kp is sitting at 3, and the solar wind at L1 is steady at about four-ten. Nothing's moving yet. But we're not going to wait on a Kp 6 warning that might give us thirty minutes before the shock hits.

transcript.speaker: Superior Range
transcript.text: So what's NLTO doing? If you bring Cloquet's SVC on, tell us before you do it. Two hundred MVAR at Cloquet moves our voltage schedule at the tie, and I don't want my operators chasing it with my banks already in.

transcript.speaker: Superior Range
transcript.text: Okay. And your Iron Range and Hartley banks, are those going in too, and what time? I need a number to put in my log.

transcript.speaker: Superior Range
transcript.text: UMRC, I see the bridge still has you at Alert. Are you staying there, or is something coming? I'd like all of us telling our entities the same thing this morning.

transcript.speaker: Superior Range
transcript.text: Copy. I'll call back when our banks are in. Superior Range clear.

voiceStyles.UMRC Shift Manager: Played live by the RC Shift Manager

instructorNote: Narrative clock is 09:30 CDT. The neighbor's early move pushes NLTO to use the lead time NGDOP 4 allows and start the Condition 2 actions now: energize the Cloquet SVC and the Iron Range and Hartley banks, coordinate the switching time with Superior Range, bring in the second supervisor and the RE, notify the 14 entities and log why. Watch whether the RC records the early action but keeps the level at Alert (UGFNWC 4), and whether the players agree on one shared message.
